verses.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.pt: Esperei com paciência pelo Senhor, e ele se inclinou para mim e ouviu o meu clamor.
verses.en_web: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm.> When I was waiting quietly for the Lord, his heart was turned to me, and he gave ear to my cry.

verses.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.pt: Também me tirou duma cova de destruição, dum charco de lodo; pôs os meus pés sobre uma rocha, firmou os meus passos.
verses.en_web: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.en_bbe: He took me up out of a deep waste place, out of the soft and sticky earth; he put my feet on a rock, and made my steps certain.

verses.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.pt: Pôs na minha boca um cântico novo, um hino ao nosso Deus; muitos verão isso e temerão, e confiarão no Senhor.
verses.en_web: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And he put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God; numbers have seen it with fear, and put their faith in the Lord.

verses.en: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que faz do Senhor a sua confiança, e que não atenta para os soberbos nem para os apóstatas mentirosos.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who has faith in the Lord, and does not give honour to the men of pride or to those who are turned away to deceit.

verses.en: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.pt: Muitas são, Senhor, Deus meu, as maravilhas que tens operado e os teus pensamentos para conosco; ninguém há que se possa comparar a ti; eu quisera anunciá-los, e manifestá-los, mas são mais do que se podem contar.
verses.en_web: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord my God, great are the wonders which you have done in your thought for us; it is not possible to put them out in order before you; when I would give an account of them, their number is greater than I may say.

verses.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.pt: Sacrifício e oferta não desejas; abriste-me os ouvidos; holocauto e oferta de expiação pelo pecado não reclamaste.
verses.en_web: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.en_bbe: You had no desire for offerings of beasts or fruits of the earth; ears you made for me: for burned offerings and sin offerings you made no request.

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.pt: Então disse eu: Eis aqui venho; no rolo do livro está escrito a meu respeito:
verses.en_web: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
verses.en_bbe: Then I said, See, I come; it is recorded of me in the roll of the book,

verses.en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.pt: Deleito-me em fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus meu; sim, a tua lei está dentro do meu coração.
verses.en_web: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
verses.en_bbe: My delight is to do your pleasure, O my God; truly, your law is in my heart.

verses.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
verses.pt: Tenho proclamado boas-novas de justiça na grande congregação; eis que não retive os meus lábios;
verses.en_web: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
verses.en_bbe: I have given news of righteousness in the great meeting; O Lord, you have knowledge that I have not kept back my words.

verses.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.pt: Não ocultei dentro do meu coração a tua justiça; apregoei a tua fidelidade e a tua salvação; não escondi da grande congregação a tua benignidade e a tua verdade.
verses.en_web: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.en_bbe: Your righteousness has not been folded away in my heart; I have made clear your true word and your salvation; I have not kept secret your mercy or your faith from the great meeting.

verses.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.pt: Não detenhas para comigo, Senhor a tua compaixão; a tua benignidade e a tua fidelidade sempre me guardem.
verses.en_web: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
verses.en_bbe: Take not away your gentle mercies from me, O Lord; let your mercy and your faith keep me safe for ever.

verses.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.pt: Pois males sem número me têm rodeado; as minhas iniqüidades me têm alcançado, de modo que não posso ver; são mais numerosas do que os cabelos da minha cabeça, pelo que desfalece o meu coração.
verses.en_web: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
verses.en_bbe: For unnumbered evils are round about me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I am bent down with their weight; they are more than the hairs of my head, my strength is gone because of them.

verses.en: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.pt: Digna-te, Senhor, livra-me; Senhor, apressa-te em meu auxílio.
verses.en_web: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Be pleased, O Lord, to take me out of danger; O Lord, come quickly and give me help.

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.pt: Sejam à uma envergonhados e confundidos os que buscam a minha vida para destruí-la; tornem atrás e confundam-se os que me desejam o mal.
verses.en_web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
verses.en_bbe: Let those who go after my soul for its destruction have shame and trouble together; let them be turned back and made foolish who take pleasure in my trouble.

verses.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.pt: Desolados sejam em razão da sua afronta os que me dizem: Ah! Ah!
verses.en_web: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.en_bbe: Let those who say to me, Aha, aha! be surprised because of their shame.

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
verses.pt: Regozijem-se e alegrem-se em ti todos os que te buscam. Digam continuamente os que amam a tua salvação: Engrandecido seja o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
verses.en_bbe: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May the Lord be great.

verses.en: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.pt: Eu, na verdade, sou pobre e necessitado, mas o Senhor cuida de mim. Tu és o meu auxílio e o meu libertador; não te detenhas, ó Deus meu.
verses.en_web: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
verses.en_bbe: Though I am poor and in need, the Lord has me in mind; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O my God.
